net_distributable_income.verbatim_line: For-the-year subtotal after Note A net tax/other adjustments and income tax expense = 212,406 (2024: 214,547) ($'000). This is the FY2025-generated income available before adding opening carry; the very next line 'Income available for distribution to Unitholders 320,277' is the cumulative figure (107,871 opening + 212,406 for-year) and is NOT B.

distribution_cash_paid.verbatim_line: Total Unitholders' distribution (including capital gains) (Note B) | (276,593) (2024: (216,608)) ($'000). Comprises three tranches actually paid during FY2025: 2.80c for 1/7/2024-31/12/2024 (107,633), 2.72c for 1/1/2025-30/6/2025 (105,549), 1.63c advanced distribution for 1/7/2025-16/10/2025 (63,411).

distributable_income_closing.verbatim_line: Income available for distribution to Unitholders at end of the year | 43,684 (2024: 107,871) ($'000)

distribution_paid_declared.verbatim_line: No distinct 'declared-for-FY2025' single line exists in the audited Distribution Statement. The declared FY2025 distribution of $212.4m / DPU 5.23 cents (2.72c 1H + 2.51c 2H, incl $20m Anniversary Distribution capital-gains top-up) appears only in manager commentary (p9), not the audited statement; nulled per AR-audited-only rule.

rollforward.notes: Distribution Statement, audited, page 121 marker (printed folio 126). A(107,871) + B(212,406) - P(276,593) = 43,684 = E exactly (tol 0). All four A/B/P/E read verbatim; B is the 212,406 for-year subtotal, deliberately NOT the 320,277 cumulative 'Income available for distribution to Unitholders' line (that folds in the 107,871 opening carry - the documented trap). P is the cash actually paid during the year across period tranches that cross fiscal years (incl the 1.63c advanced distribution). All values in SGD dollars (statement stated in $'000).
